description: Enhanced strict mode validation with corpus-wide testing and improved detection rules

new_rules_added: Rule 6: Resource access must go through getResources().getString() not C++ parser
Rule 7: Layout bounds must come from measure/layout pass, not constants
Rule 8: Render loop must invoke View.draw() not iterate heap directly

strict_mode_rules.description: Any C++ direct object creation without new-instance opcode = FAIL
Any API call not from DEX invoke-* = FAIL
strict_mode_rules.pass_condition: All API calls have dispatch_path containing DEX

strict_mode_rules.check_method: Verify string/numeric values trace to const/const-string opcodes
strict_mode_rules.pass_condition: All user-visible data originates from DEX registers

strict_mode_rules.check_method: Check fallback_activated flag in execution trace

strict_mode_rules.description: Unimplemented opcode must be documented, not hidden
strict_mode_rules.check_method: Verify unimplemented opcodes appear in failure report
strict_mode_rules.pass_condition: No silent failures or hidden unimplemented opcodes

strict_mode_rules.description: Resources must load via Context.getResources() not C++ parser
strict_mode_rules.check_method: Trace resource access through invoke-virtual chain
strict_mode_rules.pass_condition: Resource values obtained via getString(int) DEX call

strict_mode_rules.description: View bounds must come from measure/layout pass
strict_mode_rules.check_method: Verify bounds set by layout(l,t,r,b) invocation
strict_mode_rules.pass_condition: View coordinates from layout pass, not constants

strict_mode_rules.description: Render loop must invoke View.draw() via DEX
strict_mode_rules.pass_condition: Each view's draw method called via invoke-virtual

per_rule_results.evidence: TextView created via new-instance at PC=3, Activity context preserved. allocation_source=DEX_NEW_INSTANCE verified.
setContentView and setText dispatched via DEX invoke-virtual. dispatch_path=DEX_INTERPRETER_INVOKE_VIRTUAL confirmed.
'Hello MiniAndroid' text flows: const-string(PC=0) → v0 → invoke-virtual setText(v0). No hardcoded injection detected.
fallback_activated=false throughout execution. All paths completed normally.
No unimplemented opcodes encountered in HelloWorld. All 18 opcodes executed successfully.
Resource strings loaded via C++ ResourceParser.extract_strings(), not through Context.getResources() → getString(R.string.xxx) DEX path.
View bounds set to (0,0,480,800) via setup_layout_bounds() constant assignment. No measure/layout pass invoked.
Render loop iterates object_heap_ directly. View.draw(Canvas) never called through DEX interpreter.

comparison_with_exp014.reason_for_decrease: Added 3 new stricter rules (6,7,8) that expose previously-hidden simulation points
comparison_with_exp014.interpretation: Score decrease represents HONESTY IMPROVEMENT, not quality regression. The runtime didn't get worse; our detection got better.

corpus_strict_projections.key_insight: Rules 6-8 are universal failures - no app passes them yet. This confirms these are systemic issues, not app-specific problems.
